bullets.id: Emas spot ditutup naik tipis 0,10% di $4.159 pada Kamis, lalu menguat ke sekitar $4.186 hari ini. Klaim pengangguran AS turun ke 197 ribu (konsensus 201 ribu), sementara ISM Manufaktur melemah ke 54,5 tapi indeks harga input melonjak ke 77,9 dari 71,1, menjaga kekhawatiran inflasi.
bullets.en: Spot gold closed Thursday up a slim 0.10% at $4,159, then firmed to about $4,186 today. US jobless claims fell to 197K (201K expected), while ISM Manufacturing eased to 54.5 but its prices-paid index jumped to 77.9 from 71.1, keeping inflation worries alive.

bullets.id: Peluang kenaikan suku bunga Fed Oktober sekitar 37%, tapi yield 10 tahun AS bertahan di kisaran 5,30%, indeks dolar di level tertinggi sejak akhir Juli, dan Brent dekat $100. Emas turun 6,4% dalam sebulan, menuju pelemahan mingguan kedua, dan masih sekitar 25% di bawah rekor Januari.
bullets.en: Odds of an October Fed hike sit near 37%, but the US 10-year yield holds around 5.30%, the dollar index is at its highest since late July, and Brent is near $100. Gold is down 6.4% over the month, heading for a second weekly loss, and still about 25% below its January record.

bullets.id: Level kunci: resistance $4.190–4.211, support $4.160 lalu $4.112, dengan $4.100 dan $4.000 sebagai garis pertahanan besar. Penentu utama: Non-Farm Payrolls September malam ini pukul 19.30 WIB, konsensus sekitar 90 ribu. Data kuat berisiko mendorong yield dan dolar naik.
bullets.en: Key levels: resistance at $4,190–4,211, support at $4,160 then $4,112, with $4,100 and $4,000 as the major lines of defense. The main decider: September non-farm payrolls tonight at 19:30 WIB, with consensus near 90K. A strong print risks lifting yields and the dollar.

bullets.id: Antam turun Rp5.000 ke Rp2.576.000/gram meski emas dunia naik, buyback Rp2.386.000 (spread Rp190.000). Galeri24 turun ke Rp2.511.000 dan UBS ke Rp2.535.000. Bantal struktural: bank sentral beli 289 ton di Q2 dan ETF emas bertambah 50 ton sepanjang September.
bullets.en: Antam fell Rp5,000 to Rp2,576,000/gram even as world gold rose, with buyback at Rp2,386,000 (Rp190,000 spread). Galeri24 fell to Rp2,511,000 and UBS to Rp2,535,000. Structural cushion: central banks bought 289t in Q2 and gold ETFs added 50t through September.
